# Library skills kept out of skills-library/ while their files fail this repo's secrets gate
# (handoff-loop audit-secrets, or the same rules over Markdown in sync_skills_library check),
# or while they run files of a skill that does. Each hit was checked by its shape, without
# printing the value, and is an example (placeholder, URL builder, fixture), not a credential.
# The gate stays exactly as it is: the library rewrites those lines, and the next sync drops the
# name from this list. Checked by scripts/sync_skills_library.py.
impeccable  # scripts/live-browser.js builds '?token=' + TOKEN URLs (10 lines)
nexus-scientific  # a placeholder OpenRouter key line in 36 generate_* scripts; redaction-test fixtures
pr-release-gate  # the reason text in ci-mirror-exempt/CleanExpo__CCW-CRM.json trips the password rule
shipyard  # its SKILL.md runs pr-release-gate scripts, which are held back above
credential-custody  # SKILL.md line 37 assigns a quoted example value (Markdown scan, 1 line)
